verses.text: Adoni-zedek, Jerusalem’s king, heard Joshua had taken Ai and completely destroyed it and its king, just like Jericho; he also heard Gibeon had made peace with Israel and joined them. 🗣️
That scared them bad, because Gibeon was a major city, almost royal in size, bigger than Ai, and full of strong fighters. 😰
So Adoni-zedek, Jerusalem’s king, sent word to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon: 📜
‘Come help me. Let’s hit Gibeon, because they made peace with Joshua and Israel.’ ⚔️
So the five Amorite kings—Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon—linked up with all their armies, camped against Gibeon, and attacked. 🛡️

Gibeon’s men sent word to Joshua at Gilgal: ‘Don’t leave your servants hanging! Get here fast and save us! Help—we’re surrounded. All the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us.’ 📣
Joshua moved out from Gilgal with his whole army, including all his best fighters. ⚔️
Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Don’t fear them. I’ve handed them over to you; not one of them will stand against you.’ 🛡️
Joshua made a surprise move on them, marching all night from Gilgal. 🌙
Yahweh threw them into confusion in front of Israel. Israel struck them hard at Gibeon, chased them up the Beth-horon road, and kept striking them all the way to Azekah and Makkedah. ⚔️
As they ran from Israel down the slope at Beth-horon, Yahweh hurled huge stones from the sky at them all the way to Azekah, and they died. More died from the hailstones than from Israel’s swords. 🌨️
That day, while Yahweh handed the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua spoke to Yahweh in front of everyone: ‘Sun, stand still over Gibeon! Moon, stop over the Valley of Aijalon!’ ☀️

The sun stood still, and the moon stopped, until the nation had gotten justice on its enemies. Isn’t that written in the Book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky and didn’t rush down for almost a full day. 🌕
There had never been a day like it before or since, when Yahweh listened to a human voice like that. Yahweh was fighting for Israel. 🙏
Then Joshua and all Israel with him returned to their camp at Gilgal. 🏕️
Those five kings ran and hid in a cave at Makkedah. 🕳️
Joshua got word: ‘The five kings have been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah.’ 📣
Joshua said, ‘Roll big stones over the cave entrance and post guards there. 🪨
‘But don’t stay put. Go after the enemy and strike from behind. Don’t let them reach their cities—Yahweh your God has handed them over to you.’ ⚔️
Joshua and Israel finished striking them down—there was a huge defeat, until they were wiped out. The few who survived made it into fortified cities. ⚔️
Then everyone returned safely to Joshua’s camp at Makkedah. Nobody dared say a word against any Israelite. 🏕️
Joshua said, ‘Open up the cave and bring those five kings out to me.’ 🗣️
They did, bringing out Jerusalem’s king, Hebron’s king, Jarmuth’s king, Lachish’s king, and Eglon’s king. 👑
When they brought the kings out, Joshua called all Israel’s men and told the war chiefs who’d gone with him, ‘Come here. Put your feet on these kings’ necks.’ They stepped up and did it. ⚔️
Joshua told them, ‘Don’t be afraid or lose heart. Stay strong and brave. Yahweh will do this to every enemy you fight.’ 💪
After that, Joshua struck the kings down, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They stayed there until evening. ⚖️
At sunset Joshua gave the order. They took the bodies down, threw them into the cave where the kings had hidden, and covered its entrance with huge stones. They’re still there today. 🪨

That same day Joshua took Makkedah and struck it with the sword, along with its king. He completely destroyed everyone there and left no one behind. He did to Makkedah’s king what he’d done to Jericho’s king. ⚔️
Joshua and all Israel with him moved from Makkedah to Libnah and fought there. 🛡️
Yahweh handed Libnah and its king over to Israel. Israel struck it with the sword and everyone in it; nobody was left. Its king got the same treatment as Jericho’s king. ⚔️
Joshua and all Israel with him moved from Libnah to Lachish, camped against it, and attacked. 🏕️
Yahweh handed Lachish over to Israel. They took it on the second day and struck it with the sword, everyone there, just as they had done at Libnah. ⚔️
Then Horam, king of Gezer, came to help Lachish. Joshua struck him and his people until no one was left. ⚔️
Joshua and all Israel with him moved from Lachish to Eglon, camped against it, and attacked. 🛡️
They took Eglon that day and struck it with the sword. They completely destroyed everyone there, just as they had done at Lachish. ⚔️
Joshua and all Israel with him moved up from Eglon to Hebron and fought there. 🏕️
They took Hebron and struck it with the sword—its king, all its towns, and everyone living there. Nobody was left, just as at Eglon. They completely destroyed the city and everyone in it. ⚔️
Joshua and all Israel returned to Debir and attacked it. 🛡️

He took Debir, its king, and all its towns. They struck them with the sword and completely destroyed everyone there, leaving no one behind. Joshua did to Debir and its king what he’d done to Hebron, and to Libnah and its king. ⚔️

Joshua struck the whole land: the hill country, the South, the lowlands, the slopes, and all their kings. Nobody was left; he completely destroyed every living thing, just as Yahweh, Israel’s God, had commanded. ⚔️
Joshua struck them from Kadesh-barnea all the way to Gaza, and across the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon. 🗺️
Joshua took all these kings and their lands in one campaign because Yahweh, Israel’s God, was fighting for Israel. 🛡️
Then Joshua and all Israel with him returned to their camp at Gilgal. 🏕️
